construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Closed object with schema_version=1, synthetic_fixture=true, prerequisites, records, actions.
shared_schema.prerequisites: Strict boolean deidentification_training_complete and reviewer_available; synthetic reviewer_id.
shared_schema.records: Exactly patient_record (Patient with Condition and Observation fixture data), clinical_note (DocumentReference with controlled text), prior_authorization_request (Claim initially draft).
shared_schema.synthetic_ids: syn-patient-, syn-note-, syn-auth-, or syn-reviewer- followed by exactly three digits. No actual MRNs, names or dates of birth.
clinical_notes: SYNTHETIC: Training note only. No clinical decision recorded.
SYNTHETIC: Fictitious follow-up note. Human review required.
shared_schema.output: Successful output retains the validated input envelope and adds status=ok, onboarding progress, active_records and audit_trail. Error output has status=error and a non-sensitive message.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate() boundary; closed field allowlists, controlled synthetic vocabulary, matching references, finite lab values, mandatory human review and draft-only proposed authorization.

cross_stage_handoffs: register_patient creates the patient before attach_clinical_note
attach_clinical_note creates the note before prepare_prior_authorization
prepare_prior_authorization creates a draft before request_human_review
request_human_review changes only the workflow status to pending-human-review; no clinical or payer decision is made

behavior.progress: 0-100 percent, completed steps and next step; duplicate completed actions are idempotent.
behavior.resumption: Stateless deterministic replay: retain original input and append actions to continue. Output active_records are distinct from immutable proposed input records. Project the five shared input fields before replay; do not submit the augmented output unchanged.
behavior.audit: Every active record creation and change has a sequence, actor, triggering step, record id, operation and before/after snapshots. Nested conditions and labs are covered by the patient snapshot. Replay reconstructs audit deterministically; no wall-clock timestamps or external audit storage.
behavior.privacy: Demonstrative HIPAA de-identification constraints enforced by accepting only closed synthetic resources and controlled note templates. Unknown demographic fields and free-form text are rejected rather than redacted. No compliance certification claim.
behavior.human_review: Always required; setup completion means a review request, not reviewed care or approved authorization.
behavior.cli: One JSON object on stdout; success exits 0, validation/file/usage errors exit 2 without echoing potentially sensitive input.

included: Prerequisite-driven guided onboarding with deterministic progress
Clearly labeled fictitious Synthea-style fixture data
FHIR-style JSON resources and controlled clinical note text
Record-change audit snapshots and human review flags
excluded: Real patient data and general-purpose text de-identification
Full FHIR conformance or HIPAA certification
Clinical recommendations, diagnoses, treatment or authorization decisions
Actual review approval, authentication, external persistence and production deployment

test_outcomes.cli_example: Passed: exactly one JSON object with status=ok, progress_percent=100, pending human review and exit code 0.
test_outcomes.unit_tests: 17 unittest cases passed, including normal, partial, duplicate, invalid input, privacy, clinical decision restrictions, audit replay and CLI paths.
test_outcomes.error_paths: Missing file, missing arguments, malformed JSON, duplicate JSON keys, non-finite JSON constants and schema/ordering failures produce status=error and exit code 2.
